title: Measure occupied spectrum and band edges
description:
Measure occupied bandwidth, band-edge behavior and relevant unwanted emissions for the exact session-approved configurations at declared low/mid/high-band points. Use the reviewed method and distinguish applicable 20 dB and 6 dB bandwidth measurements from nominal modem bandwidth or channel envelope arithmetic.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: Require affirmative matching authority.10/rf.03 clearance and observed rf.04 settings before ports or RF. This test-session authority is distinct from the later authority.12 disposition, avoiding a cycle. Denied, expired or mismatched clearance leaves execution blocked/deferred; no field or future-session permission is implied.
acceptance_criteria: Calibrated captures record analyzer settings, uncertainty, power/mode, worst-case tested conditions and applicable rule/grant comparisons. Unmeasured variants remain not assessed. Supply actual results, including failures, to authority.12 without calling this laboratory evidence a final equipment grant.
